description: Give the compaction summary the critical project context (PreCompact: plain-text stdout is read as compaction instructions, max 10k chars)

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/context-essentials.md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf 'CRITICAL CONTEXT TO PRESERVE:\n\n'; head -c 9000 "$f"; fi; exit 0

usage: Part of the default profile. Plain text, not JSON: a JSON object on stdout would be parsed as hook output instead of instructions.
